heading: Delhi jail shocker: Undertrial stabbed in neck by 2 inmates inside Rohini prison
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: An undertrial inmate was fatally stabbed by two fellow prisoners inside Delhi's Rohini Central Jail. The deceased, Pradeep alias Mohinder, sustained a neck injury from a sharp weapon. He was returning to his barrack when the alleged attack occurred on Monday. Hospital officials declared him brought dead after his swift transfer for treatment. Police are registering a case and examining CCTV footage of the incident.
